team.collaboration: Collaborate only within the team under contest rules.

execution.turn_budget_basis: official clock n/a turns vs floor 19 (7 teammates x 2 turns + 1 answer parts + 4 for synthesis)

human_constraints: You must behave like a human teammate under official contest rules.
Do not claim tools, internet, or materials that the rule card forbids.
Do not look up answer keys or hidden solutions.
Creative long-term / spontaneous problem solving under OM constraints.
No outside assistance producing the solution for the team.
Scoring packets may be incomplete in public data; stay faithful to the public synopsis.
Teams of up to 7 members under an adult coach; recommend ≥5; all who contributed stay on roster.
Long-Term problems solved over weeks/months; Spontaneous solved on-site; Style scoring component.
Outside assistance restrictions are central (coaches may not contribute ideas to the solution — details in Program Guide).
Full scoring packets / long-term specifics often membership-gated; public synopses only for many past problems.

agent_roles.name: Agent_1
agent_roles.title: captain
duties: Direct who answers and stop teammates from talking over each other.
Give the team's official answer once the group has settled.
Submit only after the format and rule checks pass.

agent_roles.name: Agent_2
agent_roles.title: primary solver
duties: Produce the first full attempt at the problem.
Show the reasoning so a teammate can check it.

agent_roles.name: Agent_3
agent_roles.title: secondary solver
duties: Attack the problem from a different angle than the primary solver.
Compare results and surface the disagreement early.

agent_roles.name: Agent_4
agent_roles.title: verifier
duties: Challenge weak arguments and demand an independent check.
Reject an answer rather than let an unverified one be submitted.

agent_roles.name: Agent_5
agent_roles.title: specialist
duties: Take the part of the task that matches your stated specialty.
Check a teammate's work once your own part is done.

agent_roles.name: Agent_6
agent_roles.title: scribe
duties: Keep the shared workspace readable and current.
Write answers in the required format as they are settled.

agent_roles.name: Agent_7
agent_roles.title: researcher
duties: Find and cite the authorities the argument depends on.
Bring counter-authority to the team before a judge does.

answer_format: Submit the complete team deliverable requested by the problem statement.
rules_text: Odyssey of the Mind. The team of 7 solves a long-term problem with its own work only; outside assistance is the one unforgivable violation. Collaborate only within the team under contest rules. The team files one shared submission. Official wall-clock timing is not encoded for this track; treat the turn budget as your clock and submit before it runs out. Simulation note: the hands-on portion is represented in text, so state measurements, setup, and reasoning explicitly instead of demonstrating them.

adaptations: max_turns is a safety budget, not necessarily the official wall-clock limit
specialist roles are a research roster overlay
physical/oral/live opponent fidelity may be incomplete in src/

crawled_excerpts.excerpt: Public synopses available; scoring packets often membership-locked. Creative team problem-solving; no outside-produced solutions; proxy for physical performance judging.

proxy_limitations: Physical props, vehicles, structures, and live Spontaneous cannot be PDF-synopses-evaluated as equivalent.
Outside-assistance edge cases need the full Program Guide sections.
